items.name: Wrightsville Beach Airlie Live Oak All Over Print Tote Bag
items.alt: Ivory tote bag printed edge to edge with teal and slate live oak and Spanish moss medallions and navy handles, resting on the sand beside a towel, straw hat and flip-flops at Wrightsville Beach, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed tote with ink and watercolor live oak and Spanish moss medallions in teal and slate on ivory, inspired by Airlie Gardens. A Wrightsville Beach carry-all for the Carolina coast.
facts: Navy or beige cotton webbing, solid color
100% spun polyester with a laminate lining, spot clean
Live oak and Spanish moss pattern printed edge to edge on the bag body, not embroidered
